svg.title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Customer Traffic
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-service-eligibility; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Customer Traffic; subtitle: Each service follows every applicable branch; unresolved checks block that service.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate check order, not risk probabilities. Evaluate the operator's actual role, destination, service, and contract terms. Telecom requirements do not automatically apply to a compute-only product.; caption: A pass permits movement to the next applicable check. A failed check sends the affected service back for remediation, not around the control. Recheck changed customers, destinations, providers, and product capabilities.; stages: label: Capacity and workload rights; value: Pass only with authorized supply and screened workloads; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Verify resale rights and EAR applicability under 15 CFR parts 742 and 744, including relevant end-user and end-use restrictions. Test tenant isolation and upstream retention settings; otherwise withhold the affected workload or zero-retention offering.; label: Voice provider obligations; value: Pass only after role-specific authentication and mitigation checks; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Map the service role to 47 CFR 64.6301 and 64.6305 for applicable STIR/SHAKEN, Robocall Mitigation Database certification, and traffic-acceptance duties. Verify supplier status and traceback procedures; unresolved requirements block voice activation.; label: Messaging and calling use; value: Pass only with documented lawful traffic and carrier registration; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Apply 47 U.S.C. 227 and 47 CFR 64.1200 to covered traffic, including applicable permission, revocation, and calling restrictions. Complete carrier-required 10DLC TCR brand and campaign registration; registration alone does not establish permission to message.; label: Reporting and exposure; value: Pass only after reporting classification and funding controls; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Classify telecom contribution and reporting duties under 47 CFR 54.706 and 54.711 using current FCC Form 499-A instructions; contribution exemptions do not automatically remove filing duties. Confirm prepaid limits, refund rules, chargeback reserves, and emergency traffic shutoff ownership.

text.title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Customer Traffic
text.tspan: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Customer Traffic

rect.title: label: Capacity and workload rights; value: Pass only with authorized supply and screened workloads; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Verify resale rights and EAR applicability under 15 CFR parts 742 and 744, including relevant end-user and end-use restrictions. Test tenant isolation and upstream retention settings; otherwise withhold the affected workload or zero-retention offering.

text.title: Verify resale rights and EAR applicability under 15 CFR parts 742 and 744, including relevant end-user and end-use restrictions. Test tenant isolation and upstream retention settings; otherwise withhold the affected workload or zero-retention offering.

rect.title: label: Voice provider obligations; value: Pass only after role-specific authentication and mitigation checks; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Map the service role to 47 CFR 64.6301 and 64.6305 for applicable STIR/SHAKEN, Robocall Mitigation Database certification, and traffic-acceptance duties. Verify supplier status and traceback procedures; unresolved requirements block voice activation.

rect.title: label: Messaging and calling use; value: Pass only with documented lawful traffic and carrier registration; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Apply 47 U.S.C. 227 and 47 CFR 64.1200 to covered traffic, including applicable permission, revocation, and calling restrictions. Complete carrier-required 10DLC TCR brand and campaign registration; registration alone does not establish permission to message.

Confirm prepaid limits, refund rules, chargeback reserves, and emergency traffic shutoff ownership.
